product: Role-based access control (RBAC) is generally available
tagline: Role based access control (RBAC) is now generally available.
what_it_does: Role based access control (RBAC) is now generally available. RBAC lets users assume a role in Databricks. When a user assumes a role, only that role's permissions apply, rather than the user's accumulated permissions.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Role based access control (RBAC) is now generally available. RBAC lets users assume a role in Databricks.
use_cases: from mixing data across use cases
